manual_description: Profiles are read from a local file. Every action on Instagram is performed manually by you.
validation_disclaimer: This build is for analysis, recording results, reporting and managing authorized campaigns. No password, token, fake follower or unauthorized automation is stored or executed.
reports_description: CSV reports are written to exports and the ZIP backup to data\backups. All paths are relative to Instageram.exe.
settings_integrity: Check database integrity on every start
header_subtitle: Portable Instagram campaign management | projects and campaigns

report_html_done: Printable report created (use Print in your browser for PDF):
report_failed: The report could not be created.
stats_invalid: Enter a valid campaign, date and follower count.
growth_chart_caption: Follower trend based on the measurements you recorded
growth_no_data: No statistics recorded for this campaign yet.

error_disk_full: There is not enough disk space.
error_readonly: This folder cannot be written to. Run the application from a folder you can write to.
error_access_denied: Access to the file or folder was denied.
